The '''''Independence''''' was an [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] by the ending stages of the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. It participated in the climactic [[Battle of Endor]] that witnessed the destruction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] and the [[death]] of [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].

==Description==
The ''Independence'' was an [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]]<ref name="Starfighters" /> manufactured by [[Mon Calamari Shipyards]]. Like other [[Star Cruiser]]s of the MC80a model,<ref name="UltimateSW" /> the ''Independence'' measured in length at 1,300 [[meter]]s,<ref name="Starfighters" /> was equipped with a [[deflector shield generator]],<ref name="Databank" /> a class one [[hyperdrive]],<ref name="Starfighters" /> and ten [[sublight engine]]s<ref name="UltimateSW" /> giving it speeds of 975 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]]. It was armed with thirty-six [[ion cannon]]s, twenty-nine [[turbolaser]] batteries, and six [[tractor beam projector]]s.<ref name="Starfighters" /> It was crewed by over 5,000 personnel and had a complement of ten [[starfighter]] [[squadron]]s.<ref name="UltimateSW" />

==History==
{{Quote|Once the shield is down, our cruisers will create a perimeter while the fighters fly into the superstructure and attempt to knock out the main reactor.|Admiral Gial Ackbar, during a briefing before the Battle of Endor|<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
By [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY]]. Because the ''Independence'' participated in the Battle of Endor, it must have been part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] by that [[time]].</ref> the ''Independence'' was part of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|naval forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Starfighters" />

At one point the ''Independence'' was critically damaged in an engagement with the Empire.<ref name="Starships and Speeders">''[[Starships and Speeders]]''</ref>

The ''Independence'',<ref name="Starfighters" /> alongside other MC80A star cruisers such as the [[flagship]] ''[[Home One]]'',<ref name="Episode VI" /> ''[[Nautilian]]'',<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> and the ''[[Defiance]]'',<ref name="Starfighters" /> and with many other ships of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]], participated in the [[Battle of Endor]], a decisive battle in the war where the Rebel Alliance sought to destroy the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] and defeat [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Rebel Alliance [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]]'s strategy for an Alliance victory was for the Star Cruisers to form a perimeter around the second [[Death Star]] while starfighters moved into the incomplete [[battle station]]'s superstructure and destroy it from the inside. The battle was, in actuality, a trap by Emperor Palpatine to destroy the Rebel Alliance, whose [[Imperial Navy|naval forces]] managed to entrap the rebel ships as the second Death Star was revealed to be fully operational, destroying several Rebel Alliance capital ships including the ''Nautilian'' and the ''[[Liberty]]''.<ref name="Episode VI" />

[[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], believing that the Rebel Alliance would not have another opportunity, convinced Admiral Ackbar to attack the Imperial [[warship]]s directly, which would protect them longer against the second Death Star's [[superlaser]] and because rebel forces could inflict more Imperial casualties. By the end of the battle, the second Death Star was destroyed, Emperor Palpatine would be [[Death|killed]] by his own [[Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]],<ref name="Episode VI" /> and Imperial forces withdrew by order of [[Vice Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]].<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Independence'' first appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]<ref name="Episode VI" /> and was first identified in the [[canon]] encyclopedia, ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' written by [[Landry Q. Walker]]<ref name="Starfighters" /> and released on [[April 3]], [[2018]].<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/564296/star-wars--encyclopedia-of-starfighters-and-other-vehicles-by-landry-q-walker|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles}}</ref> It debuted in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]]<ref name="X-wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> in the [[1993]]<ref name="LEC history">{{LucasArts|url=20th/history_2.htm|text=20th Anniversary History, Part Two: The Classics, 1990 - 1994}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|video game]], [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']],<ref name="X-wing" /> released in [[February]] of that year.<ref name="LEC history" />
